en.headline: Flag-raising at 8am, harbour fireworks at 8pm for National Day
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee leads the Golden Bauhinia Square ceremony this morning; police expect about 260,000 people along Victoria Harbour tonight and will close roads in phases from 4pm.
body: Hong Kong marks the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China today with a flag-raising ceremony at 8am at Golden Bauhinia Square in Wan Chai, followed by a National Day reception at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre. The government said Chief Executive John Lee and senior officials will attend. Community leaders and uniformed groups will be present; no public viewing area will be set up at the square.

The Police Band will perform, and a choir from N.T. Heung Yee Kuk Yuen Long District Secondary School and Yuen Long Public Secondary School will sing the national anthem, led by singers Alex Tam and Phoebe Tam. Disciplined services will give a fly-past and sea salute. Police have already closed roads around Expo Drive and parts of Lung Wo Road for the morning events.

The National Day Fireworks Display begins at 8pm over Victoria Harbour and is scheduled to last about 23 minutes, with more than 30,000 shells across eight scenes under the theme of fireworks illuminating the country. Police said past experience points to about 260,000 people watching from both sides of the harbour. Road closures start from 4pm on Hong Kong Island and from 5pm in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hung Hom and the West Kowloon Cultural District, remaining in place until crowds disperse.

Land boundary control points and MTR services will not run extra late hours. Lok Ma Chau is due to close at 10.30pm and Lo Wu at midnight. The Hong Kong Museum of Art and the Space Museum will shut at 5pm. Police and the Marine Department said they will step up harbour patrols against speeding and overcrowded vessels. The Observatory has a Very Hot Weather Warning in force, with Thursday forecast mainly fine and very hot before cloud and showers later.

zh.headline: 國慶今早金紫荊升旗 晚上八時維港放煙花
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超出席上午八時升旗及會展酒會；警方料約26萬人沿維港觀賞晚上匯演，下午四時起分階段封路。
body: 今天是中華人民共和國成立77周年。政府公布，行政長官李家超及政府高層上午八時在灣仔金紫荊廣場出席升旗儀式，其後在香港會議展覽中心大會堂主持國慶酒會。社會財達及制服團隊成員將出席升旗禮，現場不設公眾觀禮區。
警察樂隊會奏樂，新界鄉議局元朗區中學與元朗公立中學合唱團在譚天樂、譚樂軒領唱下獻唱國歌，紀律部隊隨後在空中及海上敬禮。為配合早上活動，博覽道及部分龍和道路段已實施特別交通安排。
國慶煙花匯演晚上八時於維多利亞港上空舉行，歷時約23分鐘，分八幕發放逾三萬枚煙花。警方指按往年經驗，維港兩岸約26萬人觀賞。港島下午四時起、尖沙咀紅磡及西九文化區下午五時起分階段封路，直至人潮散去後解封。
陸路口岸及港鐵當日不延長服務，落馬洲晚上十時半關閉，羅湖午夜關閉。香港藝術館及太空館下午五時休館。警方會聯同海事處加強海面巡查，打擊超速及超載。天文台酷熱天氣警告仍然生效，預計國慶日間酷熱，稍後轉多雲，有幾陣驟雨。
